      public void processQueries(Collection<? extends Query<TimedInput<I>,Word<TimedOutput<O>>>> queries)
      Description copied from interface: MembershipOracle

      Description copied from interface: TimedQueryOracle
      Observes and aggregates any timeouts that occur after providing the given input to the SUL. Stops when observing inconsistent behavior.
      Specified by:
      queryTimers in interface TimedQueryOracle<I,O>
      Parameters:
      prefix - the input to give to the SUL
      maxTotalWaitingTime - the maximum total time that is waited for timeouts
      Returns:
